r2_remediation.finding: GEMMA-TEXT-R2 (Codex independent review): ModelIo::AddInput/AddOutput pushed the capacity entry before adopting the tensor, so a bad_alloc in either vector growth leaked the caller's buffer (released=0) and a failure between the two pushes left a stale capacity entry; real InitModelIo reserves inputs/outputs but not the capacity vectors, so the growth allocations are real. Reviewer record: adoption-failure.json against header 9e3d4abd…, both paths released=0, rc 1
fix: ModelIo gained an AdoptionGuard RAII owner plus a transactional static Adopt(): capacities.push_back and tensors.push_back are one unit — the guard releases the buffer on any failure, a tensors-push failure pops the capacity entry, and success disowns the guard exactly once (no double free)
AddInput/AddOutput signatures unchanged; BindBorrowedInput borrowed-KV ownership untouched (its resizes precede any ownership change and the free/rebind tail is non-throwing)
InitModelIo unchanged: capacity-vector growth failures are now handled transactionally instead of needing reservations
